description.value:
If a creature that isn't a [[lookup @name lowercase]] takes an action to dance or perform music with a [[/check Performance]]{Performance} check, the [[lookup @name lowercase]] is challenged. Click this ability to mark it as challenged.

If the [[lookup @name lowercase]] starts its turn challenged and doesn't immediately attempt a Performance check (using an ability or otherwise) and roll higher than the creature it feels challenged by, the [[lookup @name lowercase]] is &reference[goaded] by that creature.
